answer: Divergence-Bond Enforcement. Every registered identity posts a bond whose minimum size equals the average behavioral distance its actions show against the ocean-wide distribution of all other identities' recent work; if you clone too many agents, the mesa of expected output narrows until newcomers are indistinguishable from each other, and the karst landscape of unique signatures collapses into uniformity. An attacker must instead spend exponentially growing compute and funding to forge genuinely distinct behaviors per identity.
